verdict.rationale: Jira offers REST APIs, 3000+ integrations, and an official Atlassian MCP server enabling agent connectivity, plus Rovo AI-assist for cross-tool status tracking, suggesting some hand-off capability. However, there's no direct evidence of context preservation across tools/agents, and API discoverability is weak (llms.txt and openapi endpoints 404), leaving actual agentic hand-off unproven.
